title: Catalonia Crop Fields (Mapa de cultius)
description: Official field boundaries for Catalonia, Spain, comprising 735,413 agricultural parcels converted to fiboa GeoParquet format. Data originates from the Catalonia Department of Agriculture, Livestock, Fisheries and Food crop map (Mapa de cultius), based on declarations submitted via the Agrarian Declaration (DUN). Includes crop type classification per field for multiple years (2019–2023).

## README.md
# Field boundaries for Catalonia

Provides 735413 official field boundaries from Catalonia.
It has been converted to a fiboa GeoParquet file from data obtained from Catalonia Department of Agriculture, Livestock, Fisheries and Food.

- **Source Data Provider:** [Catalonia Department of Agriculture, Livestock, Fisheries and Food](https://agricultura.gencat.cat/ca/ambits/desenvolupament-rural/sigpac/mapa-cultius/)
- **Converted by:** Ivor Bosloper
- **License:** Open License, https://administraciodigital.gencat.cat/ca/dades/dades-obertes/informacio-practica/llicencies/
- **Projection:** EPSG:25831

---

- [Download the data as fiboa GeoParquet](https://source.coop/fiboa/es-cat/es_cat.parquet)
- [STAC Browser](https://radiantearth.github.io/stac-browser/#/external/data.source.coop/fiboa/es-cat/stac/collection.json)
- [STAC Collection](https://data.source.coop/fiboa/es-cat/stac/collection.json)
- [PMTiles](https://data.source.coop/fiboa/es-cat/es_cat.pmtiles)

## Columns

| Property               | **Data Type** | Description |
|------------------------|--------------|-------------|
| id                     | string       |             |
| determination_datetime | timestamp    |             |
| area                   | float        |             |
| crop:code              | string       |             |
| crop:name              | string       |             |
| crop:name_en           | string       |             |
| crop:code_list         | string       |             |

## Lineage

- Data downloaded on 2024-11-14 from https://analisi.transparenciacatalunya.cat/api/views/yh94-j2n9/files/b4299961-52ee-4fa0-a276-4594c8c094bc?download=true&filename=Cultius_DUN2023_GPKG.zip .
- Converted to GeoParquet using [fiboa-cli](https://github.com/fiboa/cli), version 0.8.0
